entries.title: Revelation of John 15:1
segments: Then I saw another portent in the heavens--a great and marvelous portent--seven angels with the seven last Curses; because with them the Wrath of God is ended.

entries.title: Revelation of John 15:2
segments: Then I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mixed with fire; and, standing by this sea of glass, holding the harps of God, I saw those who had come victorious out of the conflict with the Beast and its image and the number that formed its name.

entries.title: Revelation of John 15:3
segments: They are singing the song of Moses, the Servant of God, and the song of the Lamb-- 'Great and marvelous are thy deeds, O Lord, our God, the Almighty. Righteous and true are thy ways, Eternal King.

entries.title: Revelation of John 15:4
segments: Who will not reverence and praise thy Name, O Lord? Thou alone art holy! All nations will come and worship before thee, for thy judgements have become manifest.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 15:5
segments: After this I saw that the inmost shrine of the Tabernacle of Revelation in Heaven was opened,

entries.title: Revelation of John 15:6
segments: and out of it came the seven angels with the seven Curses. They were adorned with precious stones, pure and bright, and had golden girdles round their breasts.

entries.title: Revelation of John 15:7
segments: One of the four Creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls, filled with the Wrath of God who lives for ever and ever.

entries.title: Revelation of John 15:8
segments: 'The Temple was filled with smoke from the Glory' and Majesty of God; and no one could enter the Temple, until the seven Curses inflicted by the seven angels were at an end.
